newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's Tedco proposes share split.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Tedco proposes share split.

text.p: Zimbabwean clothing and furniture retailer Tedco proposed on Wednesday a four for one share split to increase the number of its shares in issue.
The proposed split will reduce the nominal value of each share from 40 cents to 10 cents per share and increase the number of shares in issue to 229.9 million from 57.5 million.

"In view of the present market capitalisation of the company's shares, and the opportunities available to the group, your board believes it appropriate to increase the number of shares in issue by effecting a four for one share split," Tedco said in a statement.
Tedco becomes the second company in two weeks to propose a share split following a spectacular bullrun on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange which started last November.
Blue-chip beverages and supermarkets conglomerate Delta has already proposed a three for one share split following increases in the market price of its stock.
Tedco closed Wednesday's trading session 20 cents up at 1,160.
